text: renee: posted a compact dashboard mock. main pain: legends wrap and collide with axis ticks when panels get narrow. thinking single-line ellipses + focusable tooltips. feedback? samir: single-line + ellipses seems right for density. but how do we expose full metric names & ids for support? joel: make each legend item keyboard-focusable and show a tooltip on focus that includes the metric name and id. tooltip must be accessible (aria-describedby). meera: unit formatting question: compacting to 1.23M loses perceived precision. proposal: show compact units visually but attach aria-label with spelled-out number and data attribute with raw value for copy. renee: sample snippet in mock: 1.23M. ok? samir: looks good. prefer spelled-out numbers for SRs. avoid role="img" on numbers. joel: outliers: current approach dims outliers by lowering opacity, but that hides spikes. alternative: cap y-axis at a configurable percentile (default 99) and show a compact overflow badge at the top of the chart. clicking it opens a small panel with exact values. meera: +1. visual: draw the clipped spike as a dashed truncated line so trend is visible but the chart remains readable. badge microcopy: "View full range" for the action. samir: agree on dashed clip. accessibility: badge must be role="button" with aria-expanded and aria-label that reads the full clipped value (spelled-out). also the panel must be reachable by keyboard and contain a textual table of series values. renee: figma-bot: uploaded image 1757777788 (compact-dashboard-badge.png) joel: minor copy suggestion: label the legend header "Series" instead of "Metrics" — shorter and scans better. add hint text on hover: "click to inspect". meera: smoothing toggle: default OFF. add per-chart toggle in header and persist in localStorage before surfacing as a saved-view option. note dev perf: toggling smoothing may re-render many points; batch updates. samir: implementation notes for dev: 1) single-line legend with ellipses, focusable items with tooltip on focus 2) compact numeric display with aria-label spelled-out and data-raw attribute 3) cap-by-percentile (default 99) with dashed truncated spike + overflow badge 4) badge role=button, aria-expanded, opens keyboard-accessible panel with exact values 5) smoothing toggle default OFF, persist to localStorage. renee: action owners: samir takes aria-label pattern + localStorage, joel does badge interaction and panel, meera updates Figma frames with dashed clip and spelled-out strings. I'll upload revised frames by noon. meera: quick QA checklist for accessibility: legend items reachable by keyboard, compact numbers announced as full values, badge announces clipped value, panel includes raw numbers and can be navigated without a mouse. joel: i'll prototype keyboard interactions in the component lib and ping for a11y review. renee: thanks all :sparkles:
